T: In every life there comes a time when that dream you dream becomes that thing you do.

Mix the minces, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and a third of the garlic and roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in batches, then soften the onion and the rest of the garlic in the same pan. Add the passata, return the meatballs and simmer gently until cooked through. Cook the spaghetti, toss with some of the sauce and top with meatballs, basil and parmesan.

The paying gig after the talent show
